slides.notes: First, who we are. We are a robotics company from Seoul. Eighteen warehouses run our robots every day. Last year we made 2.4 million dollars. We grew 41 percent. This company ships real robots.

slides.title: Fixed automation and manual picking each solve half the problem

closing_runs.text: that combines 24-hour operation with 2-week deployment — no robot engineer on site.

slides.notes: What is used today? Fixed automation is fast but breaks when products change. Manual picking is flexible but cannot run all night. We are the only solution that does both.
